headers.comment: The changelog page is CHANGELOG.md rendered as HTML, markup included, so anything merged into that file would otherwise run on this origin. Scripts, images and everything else come from here -- the pages carry no data: URI, and allowing them would paint arbitrary content on this origin; the two font hosts are the page's only outside sources, and the inline styles are jaspr's own <style> block. object-src and form-action are closed because nothing uses them -- form-action does not fall back to default-src, so an injected form would post off-site without it; `base-uri 'self'` rather than none, since jaspr's pages carry `<base href="/">` and blocking it changes how every relative URL resolves.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; form-action 'self'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'

headers.comment: Static assets are safe to cache forever. .js is excluded on purpose: Jaspr's client bundles are not content-hashed, so immutable caching pins a stale bundle on returning visitors.

The changelog, for the same reason as `/` below: under cleanUrls it is requested as `/changelog`, which no extension rule matches. After a release the nav on `/` links to the new version's entry here, so a cached copy of this page is a link to nothing.
The root document. `**/*.html` does not match `/` under cleanUrls, which left index.html on Firebase's default max-age=3600.
